text: In recent times: the ventilator is made
why: At ¶154 Miss Stoner says of the ventilator, "That is also quite modern," so the story states it was made recently.

text: That afternoon: Miss Stoner says the ventilator is also quite modern
why: Holmes greets Miss Stoner with "Good-afternoon" at ¶125, and the room inspection follows their arrival, so the exchange falls in the afternoon. The story also says she expected them "early in the afternoon" (¶82).
